verdict.rationale: Dover's own AI Notetaker joins interviews, records and transcribes them, and fills the stage's feedback form (the scorecard) with notes, so the core recording-to-scorecard flow is documented first-party. Nothing in the evidence covers candidate consent for recording, and summaries are only implied by 'notes'. missing for 10: candidate recording-consent handling, explicit AI summary output, depth of documentation on how notes map into scorecard fields, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a hiring manager, interviews get AI notes and summaries — recorded, transcribed, and distilled into the scorecard with candidate consent handled

citations.quote: Dover AI Notetaker joins your interviews, records and transcribes them, and fills in your interview feedback form with notes.
Create a form once, assign it to an interview stage, and every interviewer scores candidates the same way.
It shows the candidate's details, their resume, and the feedback form assigned to the interview stage.
